page.overview:
Who is Dorje?

Dorje was a female baby snow leopard that lived in the San Francisco Zoo.

When Dr. Ian Malcolm was at the San Francisco Zoo to examine a skin fragment that Dr. Richard Levine had extracted from an unknown animal, the report on the skin was delayed due to the afternoon animal feeding inside the nursery of the zoo's research laboratory. Malcolm witnessed the feedings of a baby gorilla, a koala, and finally Dorje as he waited. While Dorje was being fed, Gelman told Malcolm Dorje like to be petted. Malcolm therefore attempted to stroke the leopard's belly, but when he reached his hand out, the female leopard bit him, though the bite failed to break through his skin.
